verdict.rationale: Claude Design can build with your real components imported from GitHub or a local codebase, sync your design system from Claude Code, and package a handoff bundle for Claude Code to implement. Designs are HTML/CSS/JS that can be exported, and one user shipped a landing page with it. However, another hands-on report says the generated code is not maintainable, and shippable output still depends on a separate implementation step in Claude Code. Missing for 10: documented explicit component-to-code mappings, production-quality maintainable code output without a Claude Code rebuild, consistent independent corroboration of shippable code.

support.subject: As a developer, designs map to production code — component-to-code mappings or direct design-to-code output I can actually ship

citations.quote: Import from GitHub, design files, or your local codebase so Claude can build with your real components.
When a design is ready to build, Claude packages everything into a handoff bundle that you can pass to Claude Code with a single instruction.
Export to PPTX, PDF, or HTML, share an org-scoped link, hand off to Claude Code
Claude's designs are HTML/CSS/JS that any editor can handle
Got something shippable in a few hours.
